description: Use when you have enough page and search evidence to record the site's business context for later rounds: business model, offers, audiences, markets, competitor domains, important/revenue pages, brand terms and content pillars. The write merges only the fields you send (null clears a scalar, omitted keeps the current value) and bumps version. It is a proposal: source is recorded as agent and lastVerifiedAt is untouched until a human confirms it in the console. Writes need confirm:true plus a unique idempotencyKey; without confirm:true it returns a dry-run preview and changes nothing. Reusing the same idempotencyKey within 24h returns the first result. Page URLs must be absolute http(s) URLs on the site's own domain. Requires the sites:write scope.
